What the app's Licenses view lists (resources/licenses/, generated by scripts/licenses/licenses.py from these entries and the archives pinned in scripts/ios/sources.txt; docs/LICENSING.md).

components: OpenShape and the libraries built into it. 'sources' names the sources.txt archives it is built from ('repo': this repository); each text is a file inside such an archive ('archive' + 'path', the archive's top folder left out) or in this repository ('repo').

qtThirdParty: the third-party code inside Qt's own libraries, read from the qt_attribution.json files of the Qt archives. Every entry must be decided: 'include' (built into Qt's iOS libraries that the app links, or may be) or 'exclude' / 'excludePaths' with the reason. An entry that is neither makes the generator fail, so a Qt update is reviewed.
linkRules: how scripts/ios/build-app.sh's license gate maps the files in the app's link map to the sources they are built from (licenses.py gate).
